chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hisham ibn Salim, who said:
Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no household of hair (of animals) or wool, except that the Angel of Death browses them five times every day.'
ai.seo_question: How often does the Angel of Death visit households with animals?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) reveals that the Angel of Death (Azrael) inspects every household containing animal hair or wool five times daily, corresponding to the five daily prayers. This signifies a continuous, subtle presence of death in domestic life, serving as a spiritual reminder (*dhikr*) for inhabitants to remain mindful of their mortality and prepare for the inevitable transition.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is none from the people of a house of fur or wool, except that the Angel of death browses them five times during every day’.
en.sarwar: 22. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim who has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the angel of death examines five times every day the faces of every member of all families regardless of their living in homes built of hairs or fur.”
